# Pixfit — full route map

> Verbatim list of every public, indexable route on `https://pix-fit.com`. Routes are emitted in three locales (`/en`, `/zh-Hans`, `/zh-Hant`). The 28 spec detail pages and 12 scanner DocType pages are statically generated; the rest are static landing or tool pages.

## Top-level

- `/` — home, brand + feature overview
- `/studio` — in-browser photo editor (Background / Crop / Size / Layout / Export)
- `/scanner` — in-browser document scanner (12 DocTypes + HowTo + FAQ)
- `/sizes` — catalog of 28 ID photo specs
- `/paper` — 7 photo paper stocks for layout
- `/templates` — print layout templates per paper
- `/specs` — custom spec manager (mm/px/DPI)
- `/privacy` — privacy posture (fully client-side)
- `/terms` — usage terms (incl. lawful-use clause)

## ID photo spec detail pages (`/sizes/<id>`)

Each one is a long-form landing page with the exact mm/px dimensions, recommended background, file-size constraints, and a 4-step HowTo + 5-item FAQ. Specs are grouped below for ingestion.

### Chinese domestic ID photos (`cn-*`)

- `/sizes/cn-1inch`
- `/sizes/cn-1inch-small`
- `/sizes/cn-1inch-large`
- `/sizes/cn-2inch`
- `/sizes/cn-2inch-large`
- `/sizes/cn-id-card`
- `/sizes/cn-passport`

### Chinese wallet-photo formats

- `/sizes/cn-wallet-small`
- `/sizes/cn-wallet-large`

### Cross-strait / HK / Macao travel permits

- `/sizes/permit-hk-macao`
- `/sizes/permit-taiwan`

### Visas (14 destinations)

- `/sizes/us-visa`
- `/sizes/schengen`
- `/sizes/uk-visa`
- `/sizes/ca-visa`
- `/sizes/au-visa`
- `/sizes/nz-visa`
- `/sizes/jp-visa`
- `/sizes/kr-visa`
- `/sizes/sg-visa`
- `/sizes/my-visa`
- `/sizes/vn-visa-arrival`
- `/sizes/th-visa-arrival`

### Chinese exam registration photos

- `/sizes/exam-cn-civil`
- `/sizes/exam-cn-ncre`
- `/sizes/exam-cn-postgrad`

## Scanner DocType pages (`/scanner/<id>`)

Each one is a long-form landing page with the exact mm dimensions, a 4-step HowTo, and a 4-item FAQ.

### ID cards (`group: id-card`)

- `/scanner/cn-id-card`
- `/scanner/hk-id-card`
- `/scanner/tw-id-card`
- `/scanner/sg-nric`
- `/scanner/in-aadhaar`
- `/scanner/bank-card`

### Driver's licenses (`group: driver-license`)

- `/scanner/us-driver-license`
- `/scanner/cn-driver-license`

### Vehicle license (`group: vehicle-license`)

- `/scanner/cn-vehicle-license`

### Passport (`group: passport`)

- `/scanner/passport-bio`

### Generic paper (`group: paper`)

- `/scanner/a4`
- `/scanner/letter`

## Sitemap & robots

- Sitemap XML: `https://pix-fit.com/sitemap.xml`
- robots.txt: `https://pix-fit.com/robots.txt` — explicit allowlist for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot.

## Structured data

Each page emits at least one of:

- `WebApplication` (root)
- `Organization` (root, in the locale layout)
- `WebSite` (home)
- `BreadcrumbList` (every inner page)
- `ItemList` (catalog hubs: `/sizes`, `/paper`, `/templates`)
- `FAQPage` + `HowTo` (every spec detail, every scanner DocType)
